## Step log

| # | Operation | Explanation |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | ITERATE | Pass 1: bubble the next extreme value to position 2. |
| 2 | COMPARE on positions 0, 1 | Comparing 3 and 1. 3 must come after 1, so they are out of order. |
| 3 | SWAP on positions 0, 1 | Swap 3 and 1. |
| 4 | COMPARE on positions 1, 2 | Comparing 3 and 2. 3 must come after 2, so they are out of order. |
| 5 | SWAP on positions 1, 2 | Swap 3 and 2. |
| 6 | MARK on position 2 | Position 2 is now fixed. |
| 7 | ITERATE | Pass 2: bubble the next extreme value to position 1. |
| 8 | COMPARE on positions 0, 1 | Comparing 1 and 2. 1 already comes before (or ties with) 2, so no change. |
| 9 | MARK on position 1 | Position 1 is now fixed. |
| 10 | MARK on position 0 | No swaps in this pass: the array is already sorted. |
